_comment: Merge-base ratchet policy (DATA, not code — ADR-0551, fixes FRIC-1781112000). The firewall's frozen reference is the gate-baseline face as committed at `git merge-base <base_ref> HEAD`, NEVER the PR-local working-tree copy: the settle protocol mandates producer regeneration and registry-drift mandates committed==regenerated, so a PR-local reference is grown by the very regen the protocol requires (the PR #670 laundering exhibit). The scm-facts emitter (the single sanctioned out-of-graph git boundary, ADR-0515 D3) reads this policy, snapshots `face_path` at the merge-base, and writes the provenance-wrapped snapshot to `out_path` (untracked + gitignored; the .generated.json suffix makes any force-add a generated-output-diff-policy rejection, and CI rematerializes it before gates consume it). `base_ref` is the configurable comparison root: adopters repoint it to their integration branch. Precedent: Betterer / eslint-ratchet compare against the merge-base; Bazel target determination anchors on the merge-base; GitHub PR merge refs make the merge-base the base tip (ADR-0111 projected-state semantics).

_provenance.authority: ADR-0551 merge-base frozen baseline ratchet; FRIC-1781112000
